name: frontend-skill-builder
description: Create, improve, and update production-ready SKILL.md files for frontend development technologies.

interface.longDescription: Generates and maintains reusable SKILL.md files for frontend technologies such as React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and more. Produces structured, production-oriented skills that follow the Agent Skills open specification, validates required fields and technology names, and preserves existing content when improving a skill. Ships a local MCP server exposing the output contract, the technology catalog, the template, the validator, and an improvement audit as tools, so the deterministic checks are machine-checked rather than eyeballed.
defaultPrompt: Create a beginner skill for building accessible React components.
Create an advanced Next.js App Router skill.
Improve my existing SKILL.md for Next.js App Router without rewriting unrelated sections.
Turn these rough notes about TypeScript generics into a structured SKILL.md.
Validate this SKILL.md and tell me which required sections are missing.
